mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies over Badger Prairie County Park with a comfortable temperature of 66 degrees.

October is Community Planning Month, with Mayor Diaz recognizing the hard work of the Planning and Development Department. Additionally, please be aware that a section of Highway M will be closed for construction from October 6 through October 9, so plan your travels accordingly.

There is plenty to do today, including live music at Bailey's Run, the World Dairy Expo at the Alliant Energy Center, and the apple cider pressing at the Farley Center. Tomorrow, you can also join a yoga session at Insight Wellness.
In a notable call from September 14, a 37-year-old Verona man was taken into custody during a traffic stop for violating terms of his probation.
Stop by for a scoop of Andes Mint Avalanche, our featured flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
